# Japan Trip Tools

Japan Trip Tools is an independent English-language Japan travel planning site with practical guides, regional hubs, and browser-based travel tools.

Sitemap: https://heroachao.github.io/jp-travel-portal/sitemap.xml
Home: https://heroachao.github.io/jp-travel-portal
Articles: https://heroachao.github.io/jp-travel-portal/articles/
Regions: https://heroachao.github.io/jp-travel-portal/regions/
Tools: https://heroachao.github.io/jp-travel-portal/tools/
Games: https://heroachao.github.io/jp-travel-portal/games/
Image credits: https://heroachao.github.io/jp-travel-portal/image-credits/

Important tools:
- Trip planner: https://heroachao.github.io/jp-travel-portal/tools/trip-planner/
- JR Pass checker: https://heroachao.github.io/jp-travel-portal/tools/jr-pass-calculator/
- Airport transfer planner: https://heroachao.github.io/jp-travel-portal/tools/airport-transfer/
- Budget calculator: https://heroachao.github.io/jp-travel-portal/tools/budget-calculator/
- Luggage planner: https://heroachao.github.io/jp-travel-portal/tools/luggage-planner/

Important games:
- Daily Japan Word Trail: https://heroachao.github.io/jp-travel-portal/games/daily-japan-word/
- Fuji Merge 2048: https://heroachao.github.io/jp-travel-portal/games/fuji-merge-2048/
- Sushi Snake Arcade: https://heroachao.github.io/jp-travel-portal/games/sushi-snake/

Editorial note: pages are written in original professional English for international travelers. Readers should verify current prices, schedules, closures, safety alerts, and booking rules with official providers before travel.
